blocks.text: Retrosynthesis synthesis ka ulat hai. Yeh target molecule ko kaghaz par disconnection ke tareeqe se kam pecheeda, saada aur aasani se milne wale compounds mein torti hai jo shuruati maadde ban sakein. Woh bonds tore jate hain jo banawat ko kaafi saada karein; disconnections ke silsile ke baad hum saada, aasani se milne wale shuruati maaddon tak pohanchte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: target molecule aur shuruati maadde do khule retrosynthetic teeron (TM ko kaghaz par torna) aur wapas aik teer (lab mein TM banana) se jure. Neeche: aniline (TM), FGI se nitrobenzene jis ke C-N bond par surkh tirchhi lakeer, disconnection se phenyl anion (synthon A, SE benzene) aur NO2+ (synthon B, SE nitric acid).
blocks.caption: Synthesis, retrosynthesis aur un ki istilahat (Figures 25.1 aur 25.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Retrosynthesis target se ulti simt mein socha jata hai; phir synthesis aage ki taraf ki jati hai. Aniline ke liye pehle kaghaz par amino group ko nitro group mein badla jata hai (FGI), kyunke nitro group benzene par seedha lagaya ja sakta hai. Phir C-N bond torne se do synthons milte hain, phenyl anion aur nitronium ion, jin ke asal reagents benzene aur nitric acid hain.

blocks.prompt: Synthon aur synthetic equivalent mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Synthon disconnection se milne wala khayali tukra (aksar ion) hai; synthetic equivalent woh asal, mustahkam reagent hai jo lab mein use faraham karta hai, maslan C6H5- ke liye benzene aur NO2+ ke liye HNO3.
